title: A re-run under a new run id holds forever on the claim its stopped predecessor left (dz1 regression; full suite red)
body: Since dz1 (5e493a2f) the run counts every in_flight_ids claim it did not make as foreign, so a re-run of an epic under a new run id refuses with claim_width on the claim the stopped first run left on a1 and never dispatches it. TestARunUnderANewRunIDIsOfferedThePreviousRunsReports fails deterministically on epic/6in (CI runs 36398581837, 36400030743; 3/3 locally) and passes at 28385b75/5d151d7b and on main; it is EndToEnd, so the -short gate never ran it. Fold with 08e5bcc0 (dispatch over a foreign claim with room): one tick owns telling a live foreign claim from a stopped run's, and the full reconcile suite is its evidence.
